HERO_INTRO: 从有测试依据的 Python 修复中积累可追溯经验。在后续相似任务中，给 DeepSeek Harness 一份有来源、有边界的参考。
Build traceable experience from test-verified Python fixes. Give DeepSeek Harness scoped, source-backed context for later, similar tasks.
RECEIPT_TITLE: Keep the draft when saving fails
RECEIPT_BODY: 独立验收确认修复来源，再把适用条件与验证记录留在经验中。
Independent checks qualify the repair source; applicability and verification records stay with the experience.
HOW_TITLE:
让一次修复，
留下可查阅的依据。

Give a repair a source
you can return to.
HOW_INTRO: 不用把整段聊天变成“记忆”。保留必要的材料，核对发生过什么，再决定何时提供参考。
Keep bounded evidence instead of a full conversation. Check what happened, then decide when the experience is applicable.
STEP1_BODY: 获得授权后，记录有限任务摘要、明确纠正与受限代码快照；关联实际仓库与版本。
Once authorized, capture bounded task summaries, explicit corrections and limited code snapshots, tied to the repository and revision.
STEP2_BODY: 在临时工作区核对原始失败、修复验收与回归测试。回合结束和模型自评都不算通过。
Replay original failures, independent acceptance and regressions in temporary workspaces. Turn completion and model self-reports are not acceptance.
STEP3_BODY: 模型提炼候选后独立复核。后续请求按代码、依赖与相关度选择少量经验，也可以拒选。
Extract a candidate with the selected model, then reverify it independently. Later requests receive scoped context only when conditions and relevance qualify.
DEMO_TITLE: 从一个保存失败的表单开始。

Start with a form
that loses its draft.
DEMO_INTRO: 2 分钟，看清楚失败、修复、验收和经验入库；再亲自运行同款工程。
Two minutes from a failing form to a verified fix and a stored experience. Then run the same example yourself.
VIDEO_LABEL: DSH-Reforge 保存失败表单案例演示
VIDEO_FALLBACK: 浏览器无法播放视频，请从案例文档下载 MP4。
Your browser cannot play the video. Download the MP4 from the example documentation.
VIDEO_NOTE: 合成数据 · 显式补丁 · 实际独立测试。本片没有模型自主编码、自动提炼或付费调用。
Synthetic data, an explicit patch and real independent tests. This video has no autonomous model coding, automatic extraction or paid calls.
CASE_TITLE:
失败时保留草稿，
通过测试确认修复。

Keep the draft.
Check the fix with tests.
CASE_BODY: 示例提供原始工程、明确补丁、仓库外独立验收与回归测试。你看到的通过结果，来自真正运行的检查。
The example includes the original project, explicit patch, external acceptance and regressions. Its passing results come from real test execution.
EXAMPLE_PREREQUISITE: 先克隆仓库并安装依赖，再在项目根目录运行；完整步骤见案例文档。无需 Key 或 DSH。
Clone the repository and install its dependencies first; run from the project root. See the example guide. No key or DSH is needed.
DOCS_TITLE: 下一步，从你的问题开始。

Find the next step
for your project.
DOCS_INTRO: 从第一次体验到数据维护，每一步都有操作说明和明确的核对方法。
From a first run to data maintenance, follow instructions with concrete verification steps.
CARD1_BODY: 先体验，再只读配置，最后决定是否开启学习。
Try the example, configure read-only access, then decide whether to enable learning.
CARD2_BODY: 准确版本、同一 profile、权限与提炼授权。
Use the exact package and host, the same profile, and explicit permissions.
CARD3_BODY: 两宿主、双平台；查看已验证的范围和边界。
Two exact hosts on Windows and Linux. Check the verified scope.
CARD4_BODY: 链接打不开、仓库不匹配、为什么没有经验。
Connection failures, repository mismatches and an empty experience list.
CONTROL_TITLE:
从只读开始，
由你决定开启什么。
CONTROL_BODY: 学习默认关闭。体验示例和阅读官网，不需要交出模型 Key。开启正式学习前，请先理解执行、共享与费用的边界。
Learning is off by default. The example and website do not need your model key. Understand execution, sharing and costs before enabling learning.
CONTROL1_BODY: 只对信任的 Python 仓库开启。验证会运行代码；本地工作区隔离不是强安全沙箱。
Enable only for trusted Python repositories. Verification executes code; workspace isolation is not a strong security sandbox.
CONTROL2_BODY: 经验、来源、使用记录与私有快照留在本机；模型共享开启后，有限修复材料会发送给指定服务。
Experience, source records, usage and private snapshots stay local. Enabling model sharing sends bounded repair material to the selected service.
CONTROL3_TITLE: 提炼次数，不是金额上限
An extraction allowance is not a currency cap
CONTROL3_BODY: 普通 DSH 对话也可能计费。未知回执保留占额，不自动重放；升级与恢复不重置已有授权。
Normal DSH chat may also incur costs. Unknown receipts retain their holds and are not replayed automatically. Upgrades do not reset grants.
EVIDENCE_NOTE: 我们验证了受限合成案例中的真实自动闭环。后续任务对照中，两检索组均未提供经验，因此尚未测到实际使用经验的收益。来源通过不代表未来任务会更好。

A bounded synthetic real-model loop was verified. Both retrieval arms abstained in the later-task pilot, so no effect of using memory was measured. Verified source evidence does not establish future-task benefit.
CLOSING_TITLE:
先跑一个案例，
再把经验带回自己的项目。

Try a small example.
Bring the process to your project.
CLOSING_BODY: 完整工程、清楚的来源、由你掌握的权限。
A complete example. Traceable sources. Permissions you control.
